HOW GRANDISON CAN HELP

From a repair to a new room.

Build a clear boiler installation brief

For a boiler replacement in Lochgelly, note the current appliance, any hot-water cylinder and whether you want to keep the same position. Tell Connor about changes in hot-water demand. A new bathroom or additional shower can affect the options to consider.

  • Boiler installation & replacement →
  • Central heating planning →

Keep repair and servicing options clear

A replacement is not the only enquiry you can make. If there is a fault, share the displayed code and symptoms for a boiler repair discussion. If the boiler is working and you want routine maintenance, ask about servicing and have the previous records ready.

Connect the bathroom plan to the heating plan

Bathroom installation can involve new plumbing positions and a heated towel rail as well as the suite. Explain if you are changing the shower, moving radiators or replacing taps and toilets. Agree the work and finishing responsibilities before products or installation dates are committed.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Build a useful replacement enquiry

Explain whether the boiler will stay in the same place and whether the property has a hot-water cylinder. Mention any other planned changes, such as adding a shower or extending the house. These can affect the options to discuss and the eventual installation scope.

  • Share photos of the boiler and surrounding space.
  • Mention any cylinder or storage tanks.
  • Explain why you are considering replacement.

Include your postcode and preferred timing. Confirm the agreed work, who supplies the fittings and any preparation or finishing tasks before booking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Does a replacement boiler have to stay in the same place?

A move needs assessment of pipework, flue requirements and access. Share photographs of the existing position and the proposed location before assuming it can be relocated.

Do you take enquiries from Lochore and Ballingry?

Yes. These are part of the wider Fife enquiry area. Availability for the specific job and postcode should be confirmed with Connor.

Can you discuss a repair before I decide to replace the boiler?

Yes. Describe the fault and appliance details. A diagnosis, the appliance condition and parts availability can inform a discussion about repair or replacement.
